body:
## Experiment findings — useful focused saving; full gate RED, optimization held

**Three small changes reduced the existing audit's observed local mean from 162.14 s to 79.10 s (83.03 s / 51.2%). The full gate failed; this candidate is not merge-ready.**

The candidate changes only `test/gh365-tier-fail-closed.sh`: Bash builtin field parsing replaces nine external text commands per path; the unchanged subsystem listing is read once per invocation; two basename calls use shell expansion. No tests, assertions, path checks, CI selection policy, dependencies or qualification contracts were removed. Candidate source: [c2d875fa](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/commit/c2d875fab7dd1bc3fb3648a2f7b94d60ed8fceb4), also retained as [candidate.patch](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/candidate.patch).

### Measurements

Fresh remote task clone from development `2454a781`; frozen baseline `c9ecd0bf` and candidate `c2d875fa` in independent disposable full clones with identical 7,412-file inventories. Serial **A/B/B/A**, `/bin/bash` 3.2.57, ten-core/64 GiB shared Mac. Monotonic wall clock includes fixture setup.

| Order | Version | Seconds | Exit | Git identity |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Base | 188.768 | 0 | unchanged |
| 2 | Candidate | 81.145 | 0 | unchanged |
| 3 | Candidate | 77.058 | 0 | unchanged |
| 4 | Base | 135.504 | 0 | unchanged |

All normalized outputs match: **5 assertions passed**, including both existing planted controls; tier counts **5,740 / 356 / 1,316**, totaling all 7,412 files. Only the random fixture-workdir line is normalized; raw stdout/hashes remain in [measurements.jsonl](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/measurements.jsonl).

**Limits:** N=2 per version, substantial baseline variability, high recorded host load and uncontrolled caches/other sessions. These are exploratory local observations, not a precise population estimate, hosted speedup, per-edit attribution, or whole-suite speedup. The parallel gate's final first-pass wait was a different suite (`gh436-merge-cleanup.sh`).

### Correctness and regression evidence

- Old/new parsing agrees on 16 real classifier inputs, including empty input, unknown/deleted paths, spaces and equals signs. Registry membership agrees across all 411 shell suite files. Failed/empty registry extraction exits 1; valid extraction exits 0.
- A deliberate broken tier assignment makes the **existing audit exit 1**. Saved original bytes and complete Git identity are restored afterward. This expected red is excluded from performance means; its dirty mutation snapshot and hashes are explicit.
- Existing focused routing/tier/registry suites pass: `ci-route.sh`, `gh35-test-tiers.sh`, `gh306-registry-bidirectional.sh`.
- **Full normal pre-push gate: 408 passed / 1 failed / 409 total**, 406 shell suites, width 4, **1,018.258 s** validator time (**1,019 s** reported by hook; **1,020.369 s** complete attempted push). Identity unchanged; envelope clean; executed set matches registry.
- `gh648-l4-285-revalidate.sh` fails both pooled and on the runner's isolated retry: `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted` during process-group observation/cleanup. Later isolated base and candidate checks both pass (**11.244 / 11.225 s**). Those later greens do **not** erase the failures or establish their cause. [GH-1063](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/1063) reports the same suite/error before this spike; causal attribution for this instance remains **unresolved**. No full base run was performed.
- The standard live-agent self-sufficiency opt-out `RELAY_SELF_SUFFICIENCY_SKIP=1` was explicit. Parallel gate results are regression evidence, not sequential promotion qualification.

Raw [full-validator telemetry](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/full-validation.jsonl), [failure context](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/full-gate-context.json), [controls](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/controls.json), and [committed provenance](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/provenance.jsonl) retain the red result. See [methodology and limitations](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/7fa7aa3790ac5f1a2823baacd7f6aa7b6dee92b9/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-16%2BGH-1111/SUMMARY.md) and the manual collector/control recipes alongside it. These recipes are evidence artifacts, not new registered tests or gate machinery.

### Disposition

**Hold the optimization.** The runtime push was refused, with no bypass. I restored the baseline test bytes at the report branch tip; the frozen candidate remains in history for review. Only documentation/ledger/receipts are being published through the normal documentation gate. Nothing is merged, deployed, removed from the suite, or adopted as production CI policy.

The useful quick win is avoiding process overhead while retaining the same checks. It does not solve the hour-long hosted qualification. Do not start a CI rebuild or weaken selection/qualification based on this spike. Preserve this candidate and resolve/attribute the full-gate blocker before any normal implementation landing.

One additional documentation-publication attempt unexpectedly selected full validation and was canceled, with no terminal summary. It is excluded from completed-run statistics; the immediate post-cancel Git status/HEAD/origin/config checks were intact. Subsequent publication moved to the disposable clone with a refreshed integration reference. No extra green gate or bypass is claimed.

**Next:** requested Agy relay QA of the frozen candidate, methodology, raw receipts and this exact issue report. Independent review is pending; its verdict and dispositions will be posted separately. Methodology approval must not be read as runtime merge approval.
